description: This file defines the EmailsDetailView class, which extends the DetailView2 class, providing custom listing and display logic for email detail views within the SuiteCRM project. It manages the setup, population of data, and presentation of email record details.

classes.name: EmailsDetailView
classes.description: A class that extends DetailView2 to customize the email detail view in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for setup, data population, and rendering of email record details.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the detail view with parameters such as module name, focus object, metadata files, template, and creation flags.

methods.name: populateBean
methods.description: Populates the focus bean with request data and fills additional fields based on existing data.

methods.name: populateFields
methods.description: Handles special fields like 'from_addr_name' to ensure they are properly decoded and set.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the detail view as HTML, optionally showing a title and handling AJAX save operations.
